An unauthenticated GET with percent encoded dot segments therefore escapes the directory and the file is returned by `BinaryFileResponse`. Reads are bounded to the extensions in `contao.image.valid_extensions`, and paths below the upload directory fail for an unrelated reason, so this is reported as a missing boundary check rather than as a general arbitrary file read. Both Apache with the shipped `public/.htaccess` and nginx with the documented configuration are affected.

### Impact

Any unauthenticated visitor can read files that are deliberately kept outside the document root, anywhere under the project directory, as long as the name ends in one of `contao.image.valid_extensions` (`jpg`, `jpeg`, `gif`, `png`, `tif`, `tiff`, `bmp`, `svg`, `svgz`, `webp`). The route also acts as an existence oracle for arbitrary paths, and on a debug enabled instance the 404 message discloses the absolute filesystem path.

**Honesty caveat, stated because it lowers the severity.** The reporter could not use this to read protected member folders: every path below the upload directory returns 500 for the reason given under Details, so the practically reachable set is image typed files outside `files/`.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-mrvp-7wmx-5m4h", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-10-09T20:53:55Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mrvp-7wmx-5m4h", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-mrvp-7wmx-5m4h"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-107844"}], "nvd_published_at": null, "published_at": "2026-10-09T20:53:55Z", "references": ["https://github.com/contao/contao/security/advisories/GHSA-mrvp-7wmx-5m4h", "https://github.com/contao/contao/commit/867c055122fdf12220f973f862082037b695b9bd", "https://github.com/contao/contao/releases/tag/5.3.50", "https://github.com/contao/contao/releases/tag/5.7.12", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mrvp-7wmx-5m4h"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/contao/contao/security-advisories/GHSA-mrvp-7wmx-5m4h", "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/contao/contao", "summary": "Contao: Path traversal in the images controller", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-10-09T20:53:57Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-mrvp-7wmx-5m4h", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "5.3.50", "package": {"ecosystem": "composer", "name": "contao/core-bundle"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": ">= 4.1.0, < 5.3.50"}, {"first_patched_version": "5.7.12", "package": {"ecosystem": "composer", "name": "contao/core-bundle"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": ">= 5.4.0-RC1, < 5.7.12"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
